description: Search public pastes by keyword, fetch known paste URLs, or scan the newest public pastes.

extractPatterns.description: Optional regular expressions to run over paste text. Matches are returned in `regexMatches`; this does not filter results.
extractPatterns.title: Extract regex patterns

includeContent.description: Return the paste text (up to the character limit) in addition to the metadata. Leave off for a smaller dataset.
includeContent.title: Include full paste text

maxContentChars.description: Character limit for the returned paste text when full text is enabled.
maxContentChars.title: Maximum content characters

maxItems.description: Hard limit on the total number of paste records returned.
maxItems.title: Maximum results

maxItemsPerSource.description: Limit on how many matching pastes or recent pastes are returned from each site.
maxItemsPerSource.title: Maximum results per site

maxPastesToScan.description: How many recent public pastes to inspect per site. Pastebin archive scans are capped at 250 keys per run.
maxPastesToScan.title: Maximum pastes to scan

mode.description: Choose how to find public pastes.
mode.title: Mode

searchKeywords.description: Words or phrases to look for in public paste content (mode=searchKeywords). Each keyword is searched independently.
searchKeywords.title: Search keywords

sources.description: Which public paste sites to include: pastebin, gist, ideone, paste_org, paste_gg. The default is all five.
sources.title: Paste sites

startUrls.description: Direct links to public Pastebin, Gist, Ideone, Paste.org, or paste.gg pastes (mode=byUrls).
startUrls.title: Paste URLs

syntaxes.description: Optional Pastebin syntax archives to scan in addition to the main archive. Leave empty for the main archive only.
syntaxes.title: Pastebin syntax archives

title: Paste Site Keyword Leak Finder Input
